fusions.name: Scent Trail
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 5 tiles to a target and bites for 12 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Feeding Circle
fusions.desc: Whirls through the water, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, 10% more for each affliction on it (up to 40%). Also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Frenzied Strokes
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Gorge
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your attacks heal you for 25% of the damage they deal for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
